memory_candidates.content: When adding a second account/tenant dimension to an existing single-account agent skill, resolve the selector exactly ONCE at the top of the flow (before any branch that could re-derive it) and thread the SAME resolved value through every downstream call (query construction, wrapper/API calls, gate checks). This prevents 'account drift' where e.g. a census runs under one account and a mutation runs under another. Pair this with per-account-keyed side files (e.g. a pilot-acknowledgement record) so an approval/gate satisfied for account A can never silently license the same operation for account B.

This nvim config repo drives .claude/CLAUDE.md generation via a Neovim-plugin extension picker (lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua's generate_claudemd), not a standalone bash script. It regenerates the ENTIRE CLAUDE.md by concatenating each LOADED extension's EXTENSION.md (per .claude/extensions.json's loaded set) in dependency order. Editing an extension's EXTENSION.md alone does not propagate to CLAUDE.md until a user runs the picker's load/sync action for that extension. When verifying 'does this propagate to CLAUDE.md', check whether the extension is actually in .claude/extensions.json's loaded set first -- if not, propagation is unobservable and that is a pre-existing condition, not a defect in the edit.
